description: Scaling Effects on Material Demand in Hydropower: Implications for Life Cycle Inventory Modeling is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sif de Visser (Norwegian University of Science and Technology). To get the project environment, use renv::restore() The following files can be found in this repository (SRC folder): A.Power-law_relationships.R - This script develops the power-law relationships and uses leave-one-out cross-validation for validation. Output: Fig. 1, Table 1, and Fig. A2. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
